submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. ONE newly drawn complete animation sprite for 04_mountain_guardian_boy, true transparent RGBA square native resolution at least 1024. Input1 authoritative identity portrait, Input2 SOUTHWEST idle for exact three-quarter front-left camera and equipment, Input3 approved primary hand-painted style. Generate one full body character only, not a sprite sheet. Character runs diagonally toward viewer-left, SOUTHWEST, face three-quarter left with both eyes visible as idle. Anatomical RIGHT hand keeps his FULL LENGTH brown staff with gold ring head, pointed butt near ankle level and small jade ring/tassel. Anatomical LEFT forearm keeps jade-gold round shield, near side at screen right of torso. Never swap hands. Gold head same structure as SW idle, small jade donut hole transparent, physical solid ornament preserved. Brown short ponytail with jade ribbons, amber eyes, gold forehead emblem, wood prayer beads, gold jade coat/armor, ivory trousers, brown gold boots. Clean bright rounded Taoist chibi HD painting and warm gold materials, no plastic/3D. Uniform global scale, fixed orthographic camera, torso central, full body with ground/root target (512,928) in a 1024 canvas. Main crown about y130, boots around y900; head about 370px wide. All ornaments and shaft tips safely inside canvas. Two connected arms/two legs, readable fingers and knee/ankle. No shadow, floor, effects, particles, text, grid, checkerboard, mirroring, warped or copied pose.
Frame01/16 RIGHT foot forward contact along southwest travel diagonal (toward lower-left), left foot trailing up-right with toe finishing push-off. Opposed arms: right staff arm swings BACK, left shield arm forward. Real shoulder/elbow movement despite equipment; staff held slightly back to screen-upper-right relative to torso, shield slightly forward-left. Lean body into run, not walking/high knees. Both feet distinct, visible gap, front knee soft, rear heel lifted.
